name: Tryly.ai Virtual Try-On for WooCommerce
author: tryly

sections.description:
🎬 WATCH THE DEMO: Click here to see Tryly.ai in action!

The #1 Problem Facing Fashion Retailers: “Will this look good on me?”

Finally, there’s an answer. Tryly.ai Virtual Try-On lets your customers see exactly how your clothes will look on their body before they buy.

🚀 Results Fashion Brands Are Seeing:
* 3x Higher Conversions – Customers who try-on are 3x more likely to purchase
* 64% Fewer Returns – When customers see the fit, they keep what they order
* Higher Average Order Value – Confident customers buy more items
* Better Customer Satisfaction – No more sizing surprises

Watch It In Action:
See the LIVE DEMO – Watch how virtual try-on transforms the shopping experience!

Perfect For Fashion Retailers

  • Clothing Brands – Tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear
  • Online Boutiques – Stand out from competitors
  • Fashion Designers – Showcase your creations perfectly
  • Apparel Stores – Any fashion e-commerce business

How It Works (So Simple!)

  1. Install & Activate – Download from WordPress plugins
  2. Connect to Tryly.ai – One-click OAuth connection
  3. Choose Your Plan – Start free or pick what fits your store
  4. Go Live – Try-on buttons appear automatically on all products

Key Features

  • Zero Setup Required – Works automatically on all products
  • Mobile-First Design – Perfect experience on phones and tablets
  • Lightning Fast – Won’t slow down your store
  • Fully Customizable – Match your brand colors and style
  • Real-Time Analytics – Track try-on rates and conversions
  • Multiple Plans – From small stores to enterprise solutions

The Fashion Retailer’s Dream

Stop Losing Sales to Uncertainty
Every day, potential customers leave your store thinking “I’m not sure how this will look on me.” With virtual try-on, they can see exactly how your clothes fit their body.

Turn Browsers into Buyers
When customers can visualize themselves in your products, hesitation disappears. They go from “maybe” to “add to cart” instantly.

Slash Return Rates
Returns are killing your profits. When customers see the perfect fit before ordering, they’re confident in their purchase and keep what they buy.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to Tryly.ai’s service to provide virtual try-on functionality.

What Data is Used:
* Product images from your store
* Customer photos during try-on (processed securely and deleted within 72 hours)
* Basic connection settings

Privacy Promise:
* Customer photos are never stored permanently
* No personal data is collected or shared beyond try-on processing
* All processing happens securely and privately
* Full details: https://www.tryly.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
Super Simple Setup – No Tech Skills Required!

  1. Install – Download from WordPress plugins or upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate – Click activate in your WordPress admin
  3. Connect – Go to Tryly.ai in your admin menu and click “Connect with Tryly.ai”
  4. Choose Plan – Select from Lite, Plus, Pro, or Studio plans based on your store size
  5. Done! – Try-on buttons appear automatically on all your product pages
sections.faq:
Is it really that easy to set up?

Yes! It’s literally 4 steps. Install, connect, choose plan, done. No coding, no configuration, no headaches.

What plans are available?

Lite Plan – Perfect for small stores ($12.97/month – 120 try-ons)
Plus Plan – For growing businesses ($27.97/month – 300 try-ons)
Pro Plan – For established brands ($59.99/month – 700 try-ons)
Studio Plan – For large enterprises ($147.97/month – 1,600 try-ons)

Will this work with my theme?

Absolutely! It works with any WooCommerce theme automatically.

What types of clothing work best?

Perfect for tops, bottoms, dresses, jackets – any clothing item where fit and style matter.

Do I need a Tryly.ai account?

Yes, but creating one is part of the setup process and takes 30 seconds! You’ll choose your plan during setup.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all! The technology loads in the background and won’t affect your page speed.

Can I customize how it looks?

Yes! Match your brand colors, button text, placement – make it feel like part of your store.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! Most fashion shopping happens on mobile, so we made sure it’s perfect on phones.

  • Compatibility: Better WooCommerce detection for multisite installations
  • Code Quality: Removed unused script loader code
  • Privacy: Added comprehensive privacy disclosure
  • Maintenance: Added proper uninstall cleanup routine

  • Enhanced error handling
  • Updated widget loading mechanism
  • Fixed admin interface issues
  • Optimized API communication

  • One-click OAuth connection
  • Automatic widget injection
  • Dashboard synchronization
  • WooCommerce compatibility
